summary: RiverNorth Opportunities Fund (NYSE: RIV) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement on September 18, 2026 for the private (Rule 506(b)) issuance of 3,000,000 Series B Mandatory Redeemable Preferred shares due September 18, 2031, $25.00 liquidation preference, raising roughly $75 million gross. The MRP pays a 6.476% annual rate, $1.619 per share, monthly from September 30, 2026, ranking senior to common and pari passu with the 6.00% Series A preferred. Proceeds primarily refinance fund debt and fund new investments. Watch leverage costs versus portfolio yield and preferred coverage.
